## tmh certificates download-pdf

Download a certificate

### Synopsis

Downloads the certificate as a PDF. Revoked and expired certificates are watermarked. Requires the `certificates:read` scope.

Scopes: certificates:read

```
tmh certificates download-pdf <certId> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for download-pdf
  -o, --output string   file to save the response to, or - for stdout when it is piped
```
